thread:
maria: Quick async sync — Synapse on‑prem cutover blockers. I pulled together the current open items. TL;DR: network CIDRs + cert rotation + image sync proxy + a small config PR. Can owners ack and call dibs? :point_down:

jon: ACK. I can follow up on firewall/CIDR rules. Do we have the final list from customer infra?

maria: They gave us these ranges yesterday: 10.240.0.0/16 (app plane), 192.168.50.0/24 (mgmt), and 172.31.200.0/24 (egress). Customer asked that we only open outbound to 0.0.0.0/0 on the NAT gateway — egress must be NATed.

sam: Image sync is still failing through the customer's proxy. Getting TLS errors on the registry pull. I raised it with infra but need someone to confirm proxy exceptions for quay.redwood.ai.

lee: I can take cert rotation + KMS key handshake. Need the service account email from Synapse to set IAM binding. Maria can you DM?

maria: @lee sending details now. Also adding the short firewall snippet they want us to apply on the bastion for smoke:```# allow control from redwood CIDRs
-A INPUT -s 34.88.128.0/20 -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -s 35.201.0.0/16 -j ACCEPT
# allow customer mgmt
-A INPUT -s 192.168.50.0/24 -j ACCEPT```

anika: I posted a tiny config PR to repo: https://github.com/redwood/inference/PR/4972 — it's the vpc route/egress fallback logic. Needs one more review and a quick unit test. @jon can you take the +1?

jon: Will review today. If we merge before tomorrow's dry‑run we should be fine. FWIW, confirm PR sets fallback to local NAT if external fails (not silent-drop).

sam: Update on proxy: infra team says the customer's proxy only allows Cert SHA pinning for external registry hosts. They need to add our registry cert fingerprint. Asking Synapse infra to do that — ETA 12h.

maria: Risk note: if cert fingerprint doesn't get added we can fallback to using airgapped image tarballs pushed via SFTP, but that requires ops time to run the import and will add ~2 hours to cutover.

ops-bot: scheduled:canary_deploy Synapse-staging -> 2026-03-18T09:00Z (owner: maria)

lee: For the KMS handshake — Synapse needs to whitelist our KMS IPs (listed in the onboarding doc). I'll open a quick runbook entry.

anika: Also flagged a potential config diff where the platform HTTP health check uses /live vs /ready; customer LB expects /live. I pushed a fallback to accept either path in the healthcheck handler. Small change but callout in release notes needed.

maria: Decisions: 1) jon owns firewall CIDR application + verification (preflight). 2) lee owns KMS/cert binding. 3) sam owns image sync followups and alternate tarball plan. 4) anika owns PR + release note. Action: everyone please update the shared checklist (linked in the onboarding doc) when you finish your step.

jon: I'll add a smoke step to verify egress NAT and post a curl test: `curl -sS https://ifconfig.me` from the app pod to confirm public IP.

sam: If proxy pinning is still pending by +8h we trigger tarball plan. I'll prepare the import commands (will drop them in the checklist).

maria: Cool. If no blockers, aim to run the dry‑run tomorrow 09:00Z. If anything blocks the dry‑run we delay and we 1) notify Customer CSM and 2) escalate to oncall infra.

lee: noted. ping me if you need the KMS audit logs after binding, I can surface those.

anika: I'll merge PR once jon gives +1, then deploy config to staging for healthcheck smoke.

maria: Thanks all — small follow up: can each owner drop a one‑line update in this thread when done? I'll consolidate before the dry‑run. :raised_hands:
